product.title: Parasailing with Miami Watersports
product.description: Soar above Biscayne Bay on a parasailing outing that combines skyline views with a guided safety-first launch. This Miami watersports experience is designed for first-time flyers and repeat adventurers alike, with equipment and briefing included before takeoff.
highlights: Parasail over Biscayne Bay for open-water and skyline views
Beginner-friendly experience with professional crew guidance
All core parasailing gear and safety equipment are included
Optional add-ons may be available at check-in

meetingPoint.name: Miami Watersports
meetingPoint.description: 3400 Pan American Dr Pier 9, Miami, FL 33133, USA

itineraryItems.title: Check-in and safety briefing
itineraryItems.description: Meet the crew, complete check-in, and review parasailing safety procedures before boarding.

itineraryItems.title: Biscayne Bay parasailing flight
itineraryItems.description: Launch from the boat for panoramic views of Miami and the bay during your parasailing flight window.

itineraryItems.title: Return cruise
itineraryItems.description: Enjoy a short return ride back to the marina after flight operations conclude.

additionalInfo: Not recommended for travelers with back problems or pregnant travelers
Bring valid government ID or passport for check-in

faqs.question: Where does the parasailing tour depart from?
faqs.answer: The meeting point is Miami Watersports at 3400 Pan American Dr Pier 9 in Miami.

faqs.question: Is prior parasailing experience required?
faqs.answer: No. The tour is suitable for beginners and includes a full safety briefing and gear.

faqs.question: How long is the parasailing portion?
faqs.answer: The flight segment is typically around 5 to 10 minutes, with a longer total boat experience.

faqs.question: What should guests bring?
faqs.answer: Bring a valid photo ID and wear comfortable clothing appropriate for on-water activities.
